d.text: Here’s a quick reminder about the payments for {[E-TITLE]}, along with your current balance and the details you need to access your registration.

d.label: Payment schedule
d.title: Important payment information
d.text:
If you have not yet made your **first payment of $1,500**, please note that its deadline was **August 1, 2026**.
If you have already made this payment, thank you for keeping your registration up to date.
The final payment deadline was **September 1, 2026**. This payment serves as the final confirmation for your travel.

d.text: The trip deposit has already been subtracted from the balance shown above.
To review or update your reservation and continue your payments, use your personal registration link: {[E-MODIFY REG LINK]}

d.title: Need help with your payment?
d.text: Simply reply to this email and our team will be happy to help.
